beats.text: Five things mentally strong people simply never do.
One. They never hand their peace of mind to people who haven't earned it.
Two. They never let a temporary feeling make a permanent decision.
Three. They never confuse being busy with being effective. Motion isn't progress.
Four. They never wait to feel motivated. They act first, and let the feeling catch up.
Five. They never rehearse, for hours, a conversation that will probably never happen.
Mental strength isn't being unbreakable. It's refusing to break yourself on things that don't matter.
